explanation: Emily published it in 1847 as Ellis Bell, soon after Charlotte's Jane Eyre. It was her only novel, and she died the following year.

claims.text: Charlotte Brontë and Anne Brontë did not write Wuthering Heights.
Wuthering Heights was published in December 1847 under the pen name Ellis Bell.
Charlotte Brontë's Jane Eyre was published in October 1847, shortly before Wuthering Heights.
Wuthering Heights was Emily Brontë's only novel.
